prompt:
Pixel-art ground texture for a top-down JRPG map: the top of a clipped garden hedge seen from above: dense small dark-green leaves The square is about 256 x 256 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Camera: classic top-down RPG map view (seen from above at a steep angle, like a 16-bit era overworld/town map), orthographic, no perspective convergence.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
It must be a SEAMLESS TILEABLE texture: the left edge continues into the right edge and the top edge into the bottom edge. Fill the entire square edge to edge with the surface only: no border, no frame, no objects, no characters, no text, no single focal feature, even distribution of detail.
revised_prompt: Create a seamless, square, tileable pixel-art terrain texture for a top-down JRPG map, depicting ONLY the dense upper surface of a neatly clipped garden hedge, seen straight from above. Entire image filled edge-to-edge with evenly distributed tiny overlapping dark-green leaf clusters; no hedge sides, soil, border, frame, objects, characters, text or focal point. Precisely matching pattern continuation at left/right and top/bottom edges. Premium modern hi-bit 2D RPG pixel art; uniform large crisp square pixels throughout, approximately 8 display pixels per art pixel, hard edges, hand-placed coherent clusters of 3–10 art pixels defining small leaves. Rich earthy green palette with 4–6 distinct flat shades: saturated purplish-red-leaning dark shadow greens, deep forest green, moss green, muted olive, restrained warm-yellow green highlights. Subtle consistent upper-left ambient illumination under neutral soft overcast daylight, clean unlit base colors, no cast shadows, glow, vignette or light pools. Strict orthographic top-down view. Absolutely NO antialiasing, blur, gradients, soft brushes, photo texture, random noise or checkerboard dithering. Square composition.
